programme.title: David Attenborough: pieśni życia
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough selects seven of the most extraordinary recordings from the natural world and explores what these sounds mean to specific animal species. Each song - from that of a lemur, through the song of a humpback whale or a lyrebird from the order of passerine birds - was recorded during the lifetime of a famous naturalist who recorded and analyzed these songs for decades. The oldest recording was made when Sir David was five years old, the latest just a few years before the documentary was created. Each has an amazing story behind it and shows how much we still don't know about the natural world. When Sir David Attenborough was born, the science of song was transformed under Charles Darwin's theory of sexual selection, which labeled singing dangerous because it revealed the singer's location to predators. The same song also gives males a great chance to be noticed by the female and thus to pass on their genes to the next generation of birds. So the males sing, and the females listen and choose the best singers because, according to them, they will be the best fathers. New scientific trends in bird song are challenging these long-held ideas. Scientists invited to the program show that in fact, in most species of songbirds, females create their own songs - and only now do they have a chance to be truly heard. However, there is a concern whether we will be able to learn all the songs of these extraordinary birds - the human loss is loud, and the planet Earth is falling silently, as the host of the program also warns. The production is a continuation of the documentary film nominated for the Grierson Award. Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Philly Special
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

This exciting journey will reveal the secrets of the hunters at the top of the food chain. Dir.: Paul Dean. USA, 2023

programme.desc: The mysterious lands of southern Europe reveal a world where nature retains its original strength and diversity. programme.title: d/s Wildlife of Singapore. Secret world
programme.desc: Singapore is a rapidly developing metropolis in tropical Asia, a city-state on the islands. But among the bustling city life, almost 30,000 species of animals coexist with people, and many of them remain almost invisible to humans. The authors of the series invite you on a fascinating journey through the city, where among the skyscrapers and highways there is an incredible diversity of wildlife, including rare species that were caught on camera for the first time. Singapore, 2020

programme.title: Canadian Arctic Archipelago. habitable earth
programme.desc: Embark on a journey through one of the most remote corners of the planet - the Canadian Arctic Archipelago. The documentary will reveal to you the secrets of a land where life seems impossible, but still exists. You will get acquainted with unique species of animals that have managed to adapt to extreme conditions, and also learn the stories of the people inhabiting these harsh lands. educational

programme.title: d/f Phantom Killers
programme.desc: When night covers the Earth, one of the most mysterious and dangerous predators - owls - wakes up. These nocturnal hunters have unique adaptations that allow them to be virtually invisible in the dark. In the documentary we explore the abilities of owls, their amazing vision and hearing, and their silent flight. Spain, 2019

programme.title: d/f Moment. Between a moment and eternity
programme.desc: Between the past and the future there is only a moment, a moment. How do living things adapt to time-sensitive moments? A flying squirrel skims the falling leaves, and a goshawk spends the afternoon hunting a rabbit. The rice fish jumps and grabs the flying water strider, just like in the circus. All these moments happen in the blink of an eye. We will admire how rich and intense the life of living creatures inhabiting the foggy bank of the river is at this very moment. Director: Lee Young-gyu. South Korea, 2016

programme.title: d/f Hunters of the Mediterranean Sea
programme.desc: In the world of wildlife, every living creature is not just part of an ecosystem, but also a participant in a brutal struggle for survival. This documentary takes us into the hunting strategies of Europe's most dangerous predators, from wild wolves to majestic eagles. We will also see how victims of predators invent their own tactics to escape. Spain, 2022

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. Migration
programme.desc: Migration is an amazing and exciting aspect of wildlife life. It helps maintain the balance of the ecosystem and ensures the survival of many animal species. USA, 2012

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. Micropredators
programme.desc: Today we will see those who survive in the wild due to their strength. Many of these representatives of the fauna can lift objects that are several times heavier than themselves. USA, 2012

programme.title: d/s Symbols of wild nature. Giants are vegetarians
programme.desc: Their multi-ton frames shake the earth as they cross the plateau of Africa. Luckily, these massive animals are herbivores and lead mostly solitary, peaceful lives. France, 2014

programme.title: d/f Life of a Turtle
programme.desc: Imagine a creature that has witnessed an entire era: it survived World War II, escaped death in forest fires and survived captivity. In the heart of Provence, among lavender fields and ancient forests, the Moorish tortoise Alaiz will tell us his story. France, 2022

programme.title: d/s Incredible life in Africa. Tenderness in Savannah
programme.desc: Africa has always amazed us with its lush diversity of flora and fauna. But how do animals use their skills to survive in an environment as complex and challenging as the Savannah? In this documentary project, we explore African animals in greater detail than ever before, exploring which senses—sight, hearing, smell, and others—help them adapt to wild conditions and survive the struggle for resources. France, 2012

programme.title: d/f Bears of Kamchatka. Beginning of life
programme.desc: A documentary film about the first year of life of brown bears born into bear families on the territory of the South Kamchatka Federal Reserve named after. T. I. Shpilenka. The viewer will penetrate into the mystery of the growing up of Russia's largest predator and visit the world of volcanoes, rivers and wild animals, where man is just an observer. Director: Vladislav Grishin, Irina Zhuravleva. Russia, 2018, documentary

programme.desc: Vào tháng 7 năm 1996, một trong những thảm họa hàng không tồi tệ nhất trong lịch sử nước Mỹ khiến 230 người thiệt mạng và vô số câu hỏi chưa được giải đáp. Đó là một thảm kịch làm thay đổi ngành hàng không mãi mãi.

programme.title: SHOOT FOR THE SKY
programme.desc: Với kinh nghiệm bay hạn chế, hai nhiếp ảnh gia thử chụp những khung cảnh độc đáo của ngọn núi cao nhất Đông Nam Á ở Sabah, Malaysia, trên một chiếc dù lượn.

programme.title: THE FOOD THAT BUILT THE WORLD S6 EP07
programme.desc: Những người có tầm nhìn táo bạo chấp nhận rủi ro lớn để mang thực phẩm Mexico đến với tất cả người Mỹ bằng cách tạo ra loại gia vị bán chạy nhất hành tinh và đổi mới sự kết hợp mang tính biểu tượng giữa khoai tây chiên và salsa.

programme.title: THE FOOD THAT BUILT THE WORLD S6 EP08
programme.desc: Jim Folger khám phá ra cách mới để đưa cà phê đến với đại chúng. Sau đó, một thương hiệu cà phê nổi tiếng khác có được thành công lớn tại khách sạn Maxwell House ở Nashville.

programme.desc: Bạn có nhớ khi tuổi thơ đến với một bên nguy hiểm? Hãy nghĩ lại những món đồ chơi kỳ quặc và những trò hề liều lĩnh ở sân chơi từng được định nghĩa là sự trưởng thành, khi chúng tôi khám phá những bộ dụng cụ khoa học bùng nổ và hơn thế nữa.

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S5 EP08

programme.title: SPECIAL FORCES S1 EP01

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: NA TRA: ĐƯỜNG ĐUA RỰC LỬA - NEZHA
programme.desc: Một cựu tay đua hàng đầu muốn chứng tỏ bản thân trong một cuộc đua nhưng lại vô tình làm tổn thương đồng đội Lily, dẫn đến sự sụp đổ của đội. Khi một nhà vô địch đua xe ảo thiếu kinh nghiệm gia nhập đội và bất ngờ tỏa sáng trong một cuộc đua ngoài đời thực, liệu ba tay đua có thể hợp tác để giành lại vinh quang cho đội của mình?

programme.title: HỎA VÂN TÀ THẦN: MẶT NẠ TU LA - THE MASK OF SHURA OF FIRE CLOUD
programme.desc: 18 năm trước, tộc Black Feather độc ác đã xâm nhập vào lãnh thổ của Master Fire Cloud và đánh cắp Mặt nạ Shura, từ đó giải phóng một linh hồn tà ác là một đứa bé. Master Fire Cloud đã nhận nuôi đứa bé để ngăn cậu trở thành ác quỷ. Khi đứa bé lớn lên, nó nắm quyền điều khiển chiếc mặt nạ và trở thành người kế nhiệm Fire Cloud với tư cách là người bảo vệ thành phố.
